title: berteroa orbiculata var. stricta
intro: Berteroa orbiculata var. stricta, commonly known as Round-leaved Berteroa, is a plant species within the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote expectoration, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Berteroa orbiculata var. stricta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
